stem: In what way has the concept of laissez-faire contributed to U.S. economic success?

options.label: A
options.text: The government can collect federal income taxes to pay for programs.

options.label: B
options.text: Businesses will adjust production levels based on market forces.

options.label: C
options.text: The government can raise tariff levels to protect domestic industry.

options.label: D
options.text: Businesses will follow regulations to comply with federal law.
